Aggregate includes the identified GP timing variants, historic GP, National and International branches. The separate Stowe infield circuit is excluded. Component identity and historical corner alignment remain draft.

The general venue configuration represents both the club Inner Circuit and Gearbox Circuit branches. Separate published club plans identify the inner loop, eastern dog-leg and outer gearbox return. Each named route is independently mapped and selectable; their union is displayed as a network rather than one lap. The unique mapped branch length is 1300.5 m and is not stretched to the catalogue distance of 1258 m.

The general venue entry includes the club named Classic, National and Bus-Stop configurations. The three published route diagrams identify the inner esses, complete National southern hairpin and eastern Bus-Stop. Their independently mapped branch union is displayed as a network, not a lap; the unlisted diagonal shortcut and outer shortcut bypassing the esses are excluded. The unique branch distance of 1125.8 m is preserved separately from the catalogue 1186 m.

The general venue configuration includes the operator named Full, Perimeter and Club circuits. The published route diagrams identify the outer Coward Summit return, inner Penrith climb, Lucy Valley and complete Joey Dunlop hairpin. Each route is separately selectable. Their union excludes the angular pit detour and is displayed as a configuration network rather than a lap. The independent unique branch distance is 1712.2 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance.

The general Driver Development Track entry is represented by the publicly identified One Kink and Two Kinks driving configurations. Both retain the full southern loop and main northern track; the second uses the inner Turn 13 return. Northern pit-parallel and angular central access cuts are excluded. The separately advertised Intermediate training route has not been independently identified and is not asserted by this set. The independent unique branch distance is 2984.4 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance.

The general venue entry displays a network of six independently identified operator configurations: Grand Prix 1, Grand Prix 2, Grand Prix 5, FIM, Sprint 1 and Supersprint. Published highlighted plans identify each component; these include the full and bypassed Mercedes Arena, western bend bypass, back-straight chicanes, Sprint connector and Supersprint closure. Each component is separately selectable. The network is a set of configurations, not a single timed lap. Parallel pit routes and unverified later fork additions are excluded. The independent unique branch distance is 4853.8 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance.

records.evidence: The operator Track One plan identifies both the southern straight and its parallel chicane while retaining the complete northern spiral. The catalogue general configuration contains both southern branches. The network groups these two independently mapped choices, excluding the separate AMC Fast inner shortcut absent from the published plan. Shared source edges count once and no diagram coordinates are copied. The independent unique branch distance is 3794 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance.

The operator publishes Standard Long Track and Long Track with Chicane events, and its facility plan identifies the complete northern loop, central hairpins and southern return. This general venue configuration groups those two independently mapped lap choices, excluding the northern training shortcuts and the paddock access spur. Contemporary bus-stop alignment and historical catalogue correspondence remain draft. Shared edges count once. The independent unique branch distance is 856.6 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance.

The operator separately publishes West, Moss B, Moss C, Villeneuve A, Villeneuve B, Lauda B and Lauda C plans. This general entry groups the earlier West and North/South course branches as separate identified laps. Later East and Charleston Peak facilities remain separate entries. All geometry uses consistent pinned independent source nodes, with shared edges counted once and no invented joins. Fine alignment, travel direction and historical timing correspondence remain draft. The independent unique branch distance is 7229.3 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance.
